currentBoundary: The checked APK probe preserves a narrow token-bank controller shell around ClaimBankedTokens, SetBankFill, BankFill, TokenBankDescriptionText, CheckTokenClaimNotification, and TokenShopButtonNotification inside the broader TokenShop owner surface.
The same probe also keeps get_TokenBankCap, get_ClaimableBankTokens, and IncreaseBankedTokens adjacent to that controller shell instead of leaving them as disconnected symbols.
This is enough to preserve a repo-local token-bank controller shell for future mapping work, but not enough to recover saved bank values or formula ownership.
